title: Foosball Table
summary: Furniture-quality foosball table combining a Tornado-style flat playing field with Warrior brand hardware (14mm rods, weighted men, leg levelers), walnut inlays, acrylic playfield surface, and a rattle-board ball return. CAD model included (SKP, STEP, OBJ, 3DM).

title: Mechanical Pinball Machine
summary: Wooden mechanical pinball machine with a functional plunger, flippers, marble-dispensing targets, and a manual wheel scoreboard, sized for 5/8" balls. CAD model included (STEP, SketchUp, MoI 3dm) plus PDF instructions.

title: Crayford Focuser 1¼″
summary: 3D-printed (PLA) Crayford-style telescope focuser sized for 1¼" eyepieces on a 10" Newtonian tube, with smooth drawtube travel and adjustable friction. STL, STEP, and SketchUp CAD files included, plus Prusa print settings and PDF instructions.

title: Flag Display Case
summary: Hardwood flag display case sized for a folded 5' x 9.5' U.S. burial/interment flag, with a laser-etched glass panel. CAD model included (STEP) plus the glass etching design (EPS file) and PDF instructions.

title: Mantel Clock
summary: Mantel clock built from Colorado cedar with a Hermle pendulum movement (model 791-681) and a rotating pedestal base for rear-access winding. CAD model included (STEP, SketchUp) plus PDF instructions.

title: Vertical Tool Cart
summary: Rolling vertical tool storage cart (Adam Savage-inspired design) built from baltic birch plywood with PVC-pipe tool holders, electrical-box bins, and 5" casters. CAD model included (STEP, SketchUp, OBJ).

title: Bicycle Maintenance Clamp
summary: Vise-mounted, padded V-shaped bicycle clamp for chain oiling, cable adjustments, and other maintenance, designed to hold a carbon-frame road bike without damage. CAD model included (STEP) plus PDF instructions.

title: Cornhole Game Board
summary: Pair of foldable-leg cornhole boards built from baltic birch and poplar, with routed 6" holes and a spar-varnish finish. CAD model included (STEP) for the board and leg frame.

title: Biplane Wooden Toy
summary: Walnut-and-maple wooden biplane toy with a spinning propeller, built using printed 2D templates traced from 3D CAD files. CAD model included (STEP, SketchUp).

title: Baby Doll Carriage
summary: Baltic birch plywood doll carriage joined with glued dado and tenon joints (no fasteners), sized to fit typical baby dolls. CAD model included (STEP, SketchUp).

title: Fan Powered Toy Car
summary: Foam-board fan-powered toy car built with a DC motor/wheel/fan kit, designed as a hands-on electricity project for kids covering motors, batteries, and switches. CAD model included (SketchUp, STEP).

title: Fidget Spinner
summary: Compact 3D-printed fidget spinner sized for younger kids, built around a 0.25" shaft bearing and 3/8-16 hex nuts. CAD model included (3dm, STEP, SketchUp).

title: Tablesaw Vertical Tenon Jig
summary: Tablesaw jig for cutting precise 22.5-degree miter angles on frame pieces, built to make the Flag Display Case. CAD model included (STEP) plus PDF instructions.
